purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_pbr_architecture.py: import seven CC0 Poly Haven PBR texture sets, build one world-aligned (triplanar) master material with per-kind instances, and swap the flat M_Canonical_* colour materials on the measured Temple architecture for those instances at the component-override level in the combined Walkthrough map. Nothing here claims visual acceptance.
architectureManifestUvNote: architecture-manifest.json: every one of the 2633 meshes has uvLayers == []; the FBX carries no UVs, so the master material projects by world position and outputs world-space normals (tangent basis is undefined without UVs).

masterMaterial.name: M_PBR_Tiled
masterMaterial.note: Explicit triplanar: WorldPosition / TilingCm -> xy, xz, yz UV sets; weights = normalize(pow(abs(VertexNormalWS), blendExponent)); albedo and ARM blended per plane; normal-map deviations swizzled into world space per plane (UDN style), scaled by NormalStrength, added to VertexNormalWS and normalized. About 61 nodes.

arm.channels: R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

height.note: Imported for a later Nanite-tessellation pass; not wired (Nanite is off on the architecture meshes).

goldMappingNote: Only applied with -PbrIncludeGold. Default keeps M_Canonical_gold / M_Canonical_goldPaving on the 596 gold architecture components.

sourceNameOverrides.reason: book: marble tables in the slaughterhouse (Bertinoro on Tamid 4:2)

profileNotes.blue: legacy name; canonical colour [0.776, 0.680, 0.497] is pale stone (House walls, cell doorways)
profileNotes.altar: the altar, hearths and stone tables; the altar was plastered (whitewashed), so plaster; tables overridden to marble by name
profileNotes.marbleHeikhalFloor: not applied: the book/canonical layer make the Heichal, Ulam and Kodesh floors gold (goldPaving), so marble is used only for the slaughterhouse tables

excludedFolderNote: Vessels (copper) and the basin water keep their materials; the sanctuary veneers/frieze/vessels (Release/*, Integrated review/*) and the Jerusalem context (Streets/Buildings/Terrain) are outside the folder prefix and are never touched.
applyLevelJustification: The canonical colour layer was applied as StaticMeshComponent override_materials (canonical-material-review.json: originalComponents overrideMaterialPaths [] -> componentChanges), so a static-mesh-slot change would be masked by those overrides; overriding at the component level changes exactly what is visible, keeps the 2633 imported mesh assets byte-identical, saves only the map, and the receipt records the previous override array per slot for restore.
limitations: Texture sets are CC0 photogrammetry stand-ins for Second Temple stone, cedar, plaster and gold; they are reconstruction choices, not sourced surfaces.
World-projected detail has no per-block alignment with the measured wall geometry; block joints in the texture do not coincide with modelled courses.
No screenshot or runtime acceptance is performed here; visual review is pending.
Nanite is off on the architecture meshes, so height maps are imported but not used.
